summary.oneLiner: Manufacturer of woven, coated and laminated synthetic (engineered) fabrics and finished aerospace and defence solutions.
summary.business: Kusumgar makes over 1,000 SKUs of high-performance engineered fabrics based on polyamide/polyester filaments and polyurethane chemistry, and has expanded into finished aerospace and military products such as parachute systems, stealth solutions and rapid-deployment systems. It serves four segments: Aerospace and Defence Fabrics, Aerospace and Defence Solutions, Industrial and Automotive Fabrics, and Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics, selling to Indian government and private integrators in India and via exports.

endMarkets: Aerospace and Defence Fabrics (FY26 31.67% of contract revenue)|Aerospace and Defence Solutions (FY26 22.97%)|Industrial and Automotive Fabrics (FY26 24.43%)|Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics (FY26 18.57%)

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Manufacturer of woven, coated and laminated synthetic (engineered) fabrics and finished aerospace and defence solutions.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Kusumgar makes over 1,000 SKUs of high-performance engineered fabrics based on polyamide/polyester filaments and polyurethane chemistry, and has expanded into finished aerospace and military products such as parachute systems, stealth solutions and rapid-deployment systems. It serves four segments: Aerospace and Defence Fabrics, Aerospace and Defence Solutions, Industrial and Automotive Fabrics, and Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics, selling to Indian government and private integrators in India and via exports.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Engineered Coated Fabric Private Limited — Wholly owned subsidiary: Acquired from Promoters for aggregate consideration of Rs 1,118.53 million (SPA dated Dec 5, 2024)
- Kusumgar Composites Private Limited — Wholly owned subsidiary
- Specialty Fabrics Private Limited — Group Company: Non-compete agreement dated June 1, 2025 to resolve common pursuit
- Kusumgar Holdings LLP — Promoter LLP: Assigned trademarks/copyrights to company for Rs 0.05 million

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Aerospace and Defence Fabrics:** Parachute and aerial-systems fabrics, Tactical clothing and specialty gear fabrics, Stealth and rapid-deployment fabrics
- **Aerospace and Defence Solutions:** Parachute systems (incl. Combat Free Fall), Camouflage nets / stealth systems, Decoys and shelters (rapid deployment)
- **Industrial and Automotive Fabrics:** Fabrics for tapes, Custom fabric solutions, Mechanical rubber goods (MRG) fabrics, Inflatable fabrics
- **Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics:** Activewear/athleisure and rainwear fabrics, Hardlines fabrics (backpacks, luggage, sleeping bags, tents)

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Aerospace and Defence Fabrics (FY26 31.67% of contract revenue)
- Aerospace and Defence Solutions (FY26 22.97%)
- Industrial and Automotive Fabrics (FY26 24.43%)
- Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics (FY26 18.57%)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Vertically integrated operations spanning preparatory, weaving, dyeing, printing, finishing, coating, lamination and fabrication, giving control over quality, delivery and cost. Backward exposure to imported materials (synthetic yarn, polyurethane resin, lamination films) - cost of imported materials was 38.91% of material cost in FY26, of which Taiwan alone was 19.37%.

customers.title: Oem (RHP)
customers.body:
- Airborne solutions company (US) - parachute systems technology/market access (exclusive in India)
- Italian advanced technical fabrics maker - ballistic fabrics
- US tactical gear company - patented camouflage fabric
- Japanese conglomerate - joint investment partner
- Government defence R&D organisation - …

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Geopolitical developments and higher global defence spending driving demand
- China+1 sourcing shift boosting Indian demand and exports
- Lumpiness from single large orders (CFF parachute order in FY25 not repeated in FY26)
- Working capital swings (trade receivables jumped in FY26); negative operating cash flow in FY25
- US tariffs (~50% total on Indian goods from Aug 2025) a risk to exports

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Follow a build-retain-extend framework in aerospace and defence
- Grow Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics with global brands
- Steadily grow Industrial and Automotive Fabrics via wallet-share and customized solutions
- Focus on high-gross-margin, high-entry-barrier products
- Continue investing in capabilities and people

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Company operates six facilities in Gujarat plus one fabrication unit in Uttar Pradesh; it intends to expand its aerospace product lines (paragliders, sails, hot-air/helium balloons, aerostats), sell its own aerospace/defence systems globally, and build coating/lamination capability for inflatables. The Offer is a pure Offer for Sale, so no fresh capex is funded by the IPO.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- High entry barriers (technical know-how, long approval cycles, customization, brand partnerships, life-preserving product loyalty, scale)
- Technical capabilities in fine-denier yarns, Nylon 6/66 handling, coating and lamination, integrated value chain
- Diversified presence across four end-use segments with independent growth drivers
- Long-standing key-customer relationships
- Technology and market access via partnerships
- Experienced promoters and professional management

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Segment/product concentration — FY26 top-3 segments (A&D Fabrics 31.67%, Industrial/Auto 24.43%, A&D Solutions 22.97%) dominate; revenue volatile as large orders are not repeated
- Customer concentration and no long-term contracts — Top-10 customers 59.52% of FY26 contract revenue; no long-term agreements with any top-10 customer
- Government/defence order lumpiness — A&D Fabrics fell 42% in FY26 as a FY25 order was not re-ordered; revenue is order-driven
- Supplier concentration and import dependence — Top-10 suppliers 51.42% of FY26 material cost; significant imports from Taiwan; no long-term supply contracts
- Geographic concentration — All six manufacturing facilities are in Gujarat
- Working capital intensity / negative cash flow — Negative operating cash flow in FY25; trade receivables rose sharply in FY26
- Export/tariff exposure — Exports 39.99% of FY26 contract revenue; US tariffs up to ~50% on Indian goods

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Execute the remaining balance of a Rs 2,371.96 million Aerospace and Defence Solutions order in Fiscal 2027 (only 23.61% executed in FY26).**
- **Expand aerospace product lines into paragliders, sails, hot-air and helium balloons, aerostats and similar products.**
- **Sell its own aerospace and defence systems (parachutes, decoys, shelters, camouflage nets) in India and globally, scouting distribution partners.**
- **Build sales teams and appoint representatives for Europe, Middle East and North American defence-fabric markets.**
- **Grow Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics by working closely with global brands (e.g. Decathlon) and capturing China+1 supply-chain shift.**
- **Expand tapes business into the medical industry with custom medical-tape solutions and build coating/lamination capability for inflatables.**
- **Continue to prioritise high-gross-margin, high-entry-barrier products to sustain sector-leading EBITDA margins.**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Follow a build-retain-extend framework in aerospace and defence
- Grow Outdoor and Lifestyle Fabrics with global brands
- Steadily grow Industrial and Automotive Fabrics via wallet-share and customized solutions
- Focus on high-gross-margin, high-entry-barrier products
- Continue investing in capabilities and people
